note: Local copies of source data, documents and pages from other sources. The copies are not in the repository (decision D79). copiedUtc is the time when the file was written on the computer of the project. On 2026-10-14, a second copy from each address of the kernels and of the NSSDC fact sheets had the same SHA-256. The files in data-src/textures/evidence are the license records of the maps: each file has notes of the project and text from the pages of the source. The files in data-src/evidence are the records of the conditions of use of the engine data.
